title: The Mender's Seam
statement: When the night first tore, a small patient figure climbed the dark with a needle of moonlight and sewed the rip closed, stitch by stitch, with thread of starlight. On clear nights the seam still glows — a fine wandering line of a hundred tiny stitches, no two alike — revealing itself slowly, as though the mending is still happening; and those who find it say it feels a little like being listened to.
